chunks: And from him, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: "For every month, an Umrah."'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about performing Umrah every month?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on expiations, this narration attributes to Imam Ali (peace be upon him) the recommendation of performing an Umrah every month, emphasizing the continuous spiritual renewal associated with the pilgrimage rites. While often understood as a recommended practice (mustahabb) rather than an obligatory duty, this tradition underscores the transformative power of frequent devotion in purifying the soul and maintaining spiritual vigilance throughout the lunar calendar.
